description: Daily calories, protein, carbohydrates, fat, fibre and water for an adult, from the Mifflin-St Jeor resting energy times an activity factor, with 250-750 kcal taken off to lose weight or added to gain (never below 1200 kcal for women, 1500 for men). Also BMI. Estimates, not medical advice.

activity.description: sedentary (desk job), light (exercise 1-3 days/week), moderate (3-5), active (6-7), veryActive (physical job or twice a day)

goal.description: kcal a day: loseFast -750, lose -500, loseSlow -250, maintain (default), gainSlow +250, gain +500

name: nutrition_targets
title: Daily calorie and macro targets
